Those groups who qualify are listed as Other Backward castes or Scheduled castes and scheduled tribes, and they can take advantage of defined quotas amongst other benefits for education, tax benefits , special government schemes, government employment and political representation.  The lists of Forward, Other Backward and Scheduled castes, and Scheduled tribes are compiled irrespective of religion.  The lists are subject to change from time to time, dependent upon social, educational and economic factors.  However, although lists are produced for those groups entitled to take advantage of the quotas, there is no such list for the Forward caste group; if a person does not belong to any of the listed groups then that person is by default a member of a group classed as Forward caste.
